notes.title: Update v1.3, Trading Cards, and Steam Points Shop
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Trading Cards and Points Shop for Paw Paw Paw is now live on Steam!
We have several animated stickers, backgrounds, avatars, and avatar frames for your Steam profile. Go check it out if that's your thing!

https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/1037910

To accompany the Steam community items, we've also updated the game to v1.3!
Here's the changelog:
[list]
[*] You can now reset your skill tree for a fee
[*] Companion can be healed by dropping health potion on them
[*] Fixed: Upgraded warrior skill "Heavy Blow" hitting everything on screen
[*] Fixed: Some upgraded skills not playing the correct animations
[/list]
Thanks for playing,
And have a good one!

notes.title: Update v1.2 - Bugfixes
notes.content:
Hey yall! 
We've just updated Paw Paw Paw to v1.2!

This is just a small patch, focusing mostly on game-breaking bugs.

Here's the full changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed: Worm eating multiple player causing softlock
[*] Fixed: King cutscene softlock if died from status effects
[*] Fixed: Missing weapons from loot table
[/list]
Thanks for playing,
and have a good one! :D

notes.title: Paw Paw Paw Update v1.1
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
First of all, thanks for playing Paw Paw Paw!

We've updated the game to version 1.1. Hopefully, it will addresses some of the common issues and make the overall game experience a little bit better! 

Here's the full v1.1 change log:
[list]
[*] Dodge/roll can now be used to cancel attack animation.
[*] Decreased player's stagger duration when attacked repeatedly.
[*] Lowered the exp ceiling. Applied retroactively, check to the nearest gorilla to see if you have new skill points to spend.
[*] Decreased payload's bomb damage.
[*] Reduced player's bomb timer to make bomb easier to use.
[*] Disabled explosion on impact for enemies' bomb.
[*] Status effects (poison, bleed, fire) now shows their damage value in float damage UI.
[*] Removed common weapons from bosses' loot table.
[*] Fixed: Obek doesn't trigger traps in cave. 
[/list]
